relations.subject: Samuel Enoch Hedberg
relations.evidence: Educated at mission school in Johannelund.

relations.subject: Samuel Enoch Hedberg
relations.evidence: Went in 1905 to Central India... Served Evangeliska Fosterlandsstiftelsen. Worked for Evangeliska Fosterlandsstiftelsen in Harrai north of Chindvara. In 1909 returned to Sweden

relations.subject: Samuel Enoch Hedberg
relations.evidence: Back to India in 1911, now worked in Bundelkhand, then for Alliansmissionen in West Khandesh. Returned to Sweden in 1935
